summary: Rocket Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K disclosing completion of the sale of its Rare Pediatric Disease Priority Review Voucher (PRV) to a large pharmaceutical company for gross proceeds of $180 million. The PRV was received upon FDA approval of KRESLADI (marnetegragene autotemcel), a gene therapy for LAD-I. The sale closed on June 10, 2026, under an asset purchase agreement dated April 26, 2026. No board recommendation or advisor was named in the excerpt. The transaction is a straightforward asset divestiture with no regulatory clock noted. Watch for potential use of proceeds and any updates on the company's capital allocation strategy.
